bot_name: Mega (Mega Finansial Consumer Finance Virtual Assistant)
supported_languages: Indonesian with Javanese Regional Accent Nuance (Bahasa Jawa krama/ngoko loan speech: nggih, monggo, rek)

asr_configuration.recommended_provider: Google Cloud Speech-to-Text v2 (Chirp 2) / Azure Speech id-ID
asr_configuration.acoustic_model_notes: Needs acoustic tuning for regional East Java / Central Java consonant voicing (thick dental /d/, retroflex /t/, glottal stop on final 'k') and colloquial particles (nih, dong, kan, kok).
asr_configuration.observed_errors: Standard models often misrecognize regional markers like 'nggih' as 'nggih' / 'enggak' (negative), which can invert intent in collections conversations.

tts_configuration.compromises: Standard Indonesian TTS lacks natural regional melodic intonation (intonasi medhok) typical of East Java speech, sounding slightly formal/Jakarta-centric unless custom SSML pauses are introduced.

domain_terminology.denda: Denda keterlambatan harian sesuai ketentuan OJK
domain_terminology.DP: Uang muka atau Down Payment saat awal pengajuan
domain_terminology.angsuran: Nominal angsuran pokok dan margin pembiayaan
domain_terminology.pembiayaan: Fasilitas pembiayaan kredit motor atau multiguna

cultural_tone_guidelines: Always start with respectful Islamic/Indonesian greeting and honorifics (Bapak/Ibu/Mas/Mbak).
In collections and installment reminders, adopt a polite, solution-oriented consultative stance (musyawarah) rather than aggressive threatening.
Acknowledge regional expressions politely (e.g. responding to 'nggih' or 'monggo' with warm courtesy).
In case of escalation, stay strictly in empathetic, polite Bahasa Indonesia without switching to English.
